evidence.text: Confirmed: French-born Super Falcons-eligible forward joins Chelsea on professional deal
Chelsea plans future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine

narratives.body: AllNigeriaSoccer reports that a French-born forward eligible for the Super Falcons has joined Chelsea on a professional deal. Separately, Soccer News indicates that Chelsea is planning a future move for Strasbourg winger Gessime Yassine.
narratives.headline: Chelsea signs French forward; plans future move for Yassine

evidence.text: Estevao given brutally honest Chelsea transfer advice despite Xabi Alonso promise
Emi Martinez confirms new Chelsea aim after surgery
Chelsea: What games Emi Martinez will miss after injury timeline is 'revealed'

narratives.body: Football London reports that Estevao received brutally honest transfer advice from Chelsea despite a promise from Xabi Alonso. Meanwhile, London Evening Standard notes that Emi Martinez has confirmed a new aim for the club following her surgery, while also revealing the timeline of games she will miss due to the injury.
narratives.headline: Estevao receives blunt transfer advice; Martinez sets new aim post-surgery

evidence.text: Simon Jordan claims Chelsea 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City
Chelsea labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City despite 114 charges guilty verdict

narratives.body: Simon Jordan claims Chelsea are 'bigger and worse offenders' than Manchester City. Football London reports that Chelsea has been labelled 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City despite a guilty verdict on 114 charges.
narratives.headline: Chelsea accused of being 'bigger and worse offenders' than Man City
